comment_regular: Oblivion ShadowLight pass-pool initializer. Mode-5 pool[6..9] each owns one stage configured for texcoord 0, wrap addressing, linear MAG/MIN/MIP filtering, and disabled fixed-function color/alpha ops. All four disable alpha blending and stencil, enable Z test/write with LESS_EQUAL, and differ only in alpha-test enable: pools 6/8 off, 7/9 on. Opaque shaders ignore the unbound stage.
